meta.title: NebenkostenCheck - Check Your Utility Bill
meta.description: Check your German utility bill quickly and easily. Free with BetrKV check, HKVO validation and dispute letter generator.

hero.headline: Put Your Utility Bill to the Test
hero.subline: NebenkostenCheck guides you step by step through checking your utility bill - according to §556 BGB, BetrKV and HKVO. No tenants' association. No lawyer.
hero.disclaimer: NebenkostenCheck does not provide legal advice within the meaning of §2 RDG and does not replace a lawyer.

betrkv.title: BetrKV Check
betrkv.desc: Every line item is checked against the exhaustive list of the German Operating Costs Ordinance.

hkvo.title: HKVO Validation
hkvo.desc: The consumption-based heating cost share is checked against the 50-70% requirement of §7 HKVO.

frist.title: Deadline Monitoring
frist.desc: The 12-month objection deadline under §556 para. 3 BGB is automatically calculated and monitored.

schreiben.title: Dispute Letter
schreiben.desc: When irregularities are found, the system generates a pre-written template letter with legal references.

home.rdg_notice: Legal notice: NebenkostenCheck is an information and automation tool. The app schematically presents the abstract legal situation based on your inputs. It does not evaluate your specific individual case and does not constitute a legal service within the meaning of §2 RDG.

register.title: Registration
register.content: Create a free account at nebenkostencheck.eu. You only need an email address and a password. After registration you will receive a confirmation email. Click the link to activate your account.

login.title: Login
login.content: Sign in with your email address and password. If you have forgotten your password, you can recover it using the 'Reset password' function.

dashboard.title: Your Dashboard
dashboard.content: After logging in you will land on your dashboard. Here you can see an overview of all your bills, their status, and the most important deadlines at a glance.

start.title: Start a New Check
start.content: Click 'Check new bill' to start the review wizard. You will be guided step by step through the data entry. Optionally, you can upload your bill as a PDF for automatic data recognition.

grunddaten.title: Step 1: Basic Data
grunddaten.content: Enter the general data of your bill: billing year, date of receipt, name of the landlord/property management, and your apartment size in square meters. The date of receipt is important for deadline calculation.

positionen.title: Step 2: Cost Items
positionen.content: Enter each item from your utility bill. Select the category (e.g. property tax, water supply, waste disposal), the allocation key (living space, number of occupants, consumption), and the amounts. Each item is checked against the BetrKV.

heizkosten.title: Step 3: Heating Costs
heizkosten.content: Enter the heating cost data: total costs, consumption-based share, and base cost share. NebenkostenCheck verifies whether the split complies with the HKVO requirements (50-70% consumption-based).

zusammenfassung.title: Step 4: Summary
zusammenfassung.content: Review all entered data in the summary. You can go back at any time to correct entries. Confirm the data to start the automatic review.

ampel.title: The Traffic Light System
ampel.content:
Each item is rated with a traffic light:
- Green: Item is correct and BetrKV-compliant.
- Yellow: Item contains notes or inaccuracies that you should review.
- Red: Item violates applicable law (BetrKV, HKVO, or BGB). Filing an objection is recommended.

beanstandungen.title: Objections in Detail
beanstandungen.content: For each objected item you will see: the exact error, the legal basis, the disputed amount, and a clear explanation. This information flows directly into a potential objection letter.

gesetze.title: Legal References
gesetze.content: NebenkostenCheck reviews against: Section 556 BGB (operating cost obligation), the Operating Cost Ordinance (BetrKV, Sections 1-2), and the Heating Cost Ordinance (HKVO, Section 7). All references are displayed directly during the review.

what.title: What is an Objection?
what.content: An objection is a formal letter to your landlord in which you dispute incorrect items in your utility bill. According to Section 556(3) BGB, you have 12 months from the date of receipt to do so.

how.title: Generate Objection Letter
how.content: NebenkostenCheck creates an individual objection letter based on the review results. It contains all disputed items with amounts and legal references. You can download the letter as a PDF and send it to your landlord by mail or email.

twelve_months.title: The 12-Month Deadline
twelve_months.content: According to Section 556(3) sentence 5 BGB, you have 12 months from receipt of the utility bill to raise objections. After that, your right to object expires. NebenkostenCheck automatically calculates this deadline from the date of receipt you provide.

notifications.title: Automatic Reminders
notifications.content: You will receive notifications when your objection deadline expires in 30 days and when the deadline is imminent. This way you never miss an important deadline.

free.title: Free Plan
free.content: With the free plan you can check up to 2 bills per year. Included: BetrKV compliance check, HKVO validation, deadline monitoring, and the traffic light system. Ideal for trying out.

pro.title: Pro Plan
pro.content: The Pro plan offers unlimited bill reviews, PDF upload with automatic recognition, objection letter generator, and an archive of all past reviews. Upgrade anytime via Dashboard > Upgrade.

theme.title: Dark Mode and Light Mode
theme.content: Switch between light and dark design via the sun/moon icon in the header. The setting is saved in your browser and automatically applied on your next visit.

language.title: Change Language
language.content: NebenkostenCheck is available in German and English. Switch the language via the language menu in the header. All content, review results, and objection letters are displayed in the selected language.

data.title: Your Data
data.content: All data is stored encrypted in the EU (Supabase, Frankfurt). You can delete your account and all associated data at any time.

rls.title: Access Control
rls.content: Each user can only see their own bills and results. The database uses Row Level Security (RLS), making access to other users' data technically impossible.

legal.title: Legal Notices
legal.content: NebenkostenCheck does not provide legal advice within the meaning of Section 2 RDG. The review does not replace legal counsel. In complex cases we recommend consulting a specialist lawyer for tenancy law.
